name: Bree
source:
Kasey’s cousin. She helps her dad run a small winery and inn. Bree is the thinking type and often is sought by Kasey for advice. Though sarcastic and at times bored, she is quite smart about the world and is a hard working. Bree though doesn’t know what she wants to do with her life and isn’t the type who likes dealing with problems. Also likes teasing others.
